title: Corswarem Group
description: corswarem.eu Corswarem Group (founded 1957, Tongeren, Belgium) is a family-owned manufacturer and installer of aluminium windows, doors, curtain-wall facades, terraces and solar panels, with 65+ years of expertise and 18–20 employees across five legal entities (Ramenconstructie Corswarem NV as the main operating company, plus Alu Design, Window Creations, Solar Solutions and holding Groep ADC BV with €18M in assets). It is a Schüco Premium Partner (30+ years exclusive) and Renson Ambassador, delivering full turnkey projects from design through production to installation — landmark works include BASF Antwerpen, Posthofbrug Berchem (17,000 m² offices), DronePort Brustem, CM Limburg HQ and the first ASE 80 HI DesignLine installation in Belgium. Led by the Corswarem family (Dirk, An, Jolien), the group booked a gross margin of €5.3M at its 2023 peak but saw profit fall 64% in 2025 to €691K amid Belgium's construction slowdown — though equity rose 44% and debt dropped 30%.
